data: For fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported record revenue of about $130.5 billion, up 114% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. GAAP net income was about $72.9 billion, up roughly 145% from $29.8 billion the year before, and GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.94. The Data Center segment drove most of the growth, bringing in about $115.2 billion, up 142% year over year.
